samples.question: The image shows two 32-by-32 grids of dark and light cells, side by side (panel P on the left, panel Q on the right), and each grid alone looks like pure random noise. A symbol was hidden between the two panels: wherever the symbol is drawn the two panels carry the SAME shade, and everywhere else they carry OPPOSITE shades, so no single panel reveals anything. Undo the declared coding by comparing the two panels cell by cell: a cell belongs to the symbol wherever both panels are the SAME shade (both dark or both light). Those agreeing cells trace a single abstract symbol, either a filled circle (A) or a filled square (B). Which symbol appears, A or B? Answer A or B.
